$comment: facebook-nodejs-business-sdk: generated from the CRUD objects of 24.0.1 (a one-off script). An object built with `new AdAccount(id)` sends through its methods (`<Class>.<method>`): `get(fields, params)` reads the node (`GET /{id}`), `update` / `delete` write it, `getX` / `createX` / `deleteX` its edges (the edge each names, as the source writes it: `getAdCreatives` is `/adcreatives`). The SDK appends the access token to the query of every request; a GET sends `fields` (joined) and its params as the query, a POST its params as a JSON body. The Graph API version is the one the installed SDK pins (`FacebookAdsApi.VERSION`, its major: 24.x sends `v24.0`), which the code cannot set: a placeholder. `EventRequest(token, pixelId).execute()` sends the Conversions API events (`POST /{pixel_id}/events`), its body built by the SDK.
